design/dist/preview/index.html, generated by deno task build from tokens.json. Each section renders twice: the dark ground (default) and the light theme.

Zentinel design tokens

Shisa orange #f68d31 and plum #9b4d8a on a plum-tinted dark ground. Contrast gate: dark: 63/63 pass, lowest 3.21:1 · light: 63/63 pass, lowest 3.45:1.

Marks

The shisa exists only as a raster illustration (1024 px PNG). The lockups below are interim: the raster disc next to a vector wordmark. A vector redraw of the mark is still needed before mono lockups, an SVG favicon and small-size marks can exist. See marks/PROVENANCE.md.

dark

light

Buttons

The family's raised "physical" CTA. Hover lifts, active presses. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the face stays put and only the colour changes. Tab to see the focus ring.

dark

Get started Plain link

Surface card

Text on surface with a link, muted copy, accent text and accent-2 text. Select this text to see the selection colours.

listeners {
    listener "https" {
        address "0.0.0.0:443"
        protocol "https"  // TLS via per-SNI certs
    }
}

success: upstream healthy

warn: agent in fail-open mode

danger: request blocked by WAF

info: config reloaded on SIGHUP
